QuestInfo.name: Unfamiliar Hillside
QuestInfo.1: You destroyed the altar at Honnou-ji and stopped the ritual to summon the demon king, you must have passed out at some point. There's got to be someone around here.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, Naoe Kanetsugu witnessed the event. He'll know what happened during that incident.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 621 Can proceed to the Zipangu's World quest

1.0: Kanna! Get your wits about you, there's work to be done. Oh that's right... You don't know what happened, do you? Pay attention, because I don't wish to repeat myself. Make sure you understand it the first time.
